$comment: Deny-by-default allowlist for the Ask WM3 archive index.
Only paths matching `allow` are ever read by scripts/ingest.mjs.
READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A PATH: the index is a static file served to the
browser, so every chunk that goes in becomes public, verbatim, to anyone
who opens devtools. That is fine for linkedin/posts, which are already
published on LinkedIn and carry a canonical `url` in their frontmatter.
It is NOT fine for anything unpublished. The voice pages, framework.md,
playbook.md and learnings.md are deliberately excluded on those grounds —
they are the playbook, not the posts. Publishing them is a decision to
make on purpose, not by widening a glob.
$siteComment: wm3/site/*.md is written in this repo and describes pages already published on wm3.ai — the builds, talks and life chapters the Ask WM3 copy promises to answer from. It is authored to be public.
$frontmatterComment: analytics, ai_score, ai_role and notes are dropped at ingest — engagement numbers are data, not quotable knowledge.
